2 21-03-2023 Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State.
Let the defect(s), if any, be removed within a period of four weeks from today.

The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Lakhnaur P.S. Case No. 189 of 2021 corresponding to G.R. No. 1713 of 2021 registered for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 379, 498A, 504, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
The accused/petitioner is named in the F.I.R. and is in custody since 28.09.2022.

The allegation against the petitioner is to commit Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.73637 of 2022(2)
dt.21-03-2023 cruelty against informant, who is wife of this petitioner due to non-fulfillment of the demand of dowry as raised for a motorcycle and a buffalo.

It is also alleged that on non- fulfillment of aforesaid demand, the informant with her three minor children were ousted from her Santosh Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80577238/
1 matrimonial home after causing physical assault.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submitted that the allegation against petitioner is appearing false on its face, as petitioner living happily with informant and three children and out of some misunderstanding arises out of family disputes, the present false implication was raised.

entities.text: Santosh Yadav vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the matter may be sent to mediation centre of this Court for effective and professional mediation as to redress the present issues between the parties.

Learned APP duly assisted by learned counsel Mr. Amar Nath Yadav appearing for the informant also appears in agreement to send this matter before mediation centre of this Court for effective redressal.

Considering the submission, as advanced by the parties, the petitioner is directed to released on "provisional bail" till further order in connection with Lakhnaur P.S. Case No. 189 of 2021 corresponding to G.R. No. 1713 of 2021 on Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.73637 of 2022(2)
dt.21-03-2023 furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-I, Jhanjharpur,
Madhubani/concerned Court, subject to the conditions as mentioned under Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
Both parties are directed to appear before mediation centre of this Court as first sitting on 11.04.2023, where mediation centre is directed to place its final report preferably within three (03)
months of this order.
Petitioner is directed to pay Rs. 2,000/- (Rupees Two Thousand) to informant on each date when the matter fixed for mediation, as travelling, fooding and lodging expenditure.
List this matter after receiving of final report of mediation centre or on 22.06.2023, whichever is earlier.

(Chandra Shekhar Jha, J) Archana/-
